name: Ayasaki Takako
source:
A girl who attends Kayou Private Academy. [url=/c16800]Nana’s[/url] classmate.

Her great grandmother was a Caucasian, so her hair is almost blonde.

She fell in love at first sight with [url=/c4086]Shuugo[/url] when they met back when he was a police officer, and even now still holds onto those pure feelings.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=116]MangaGamer[/url]]
